title.zh-CN: 体检发现肝多发占位 · 55岁女性
title.en: Multiple liver lesions found at a check-up · woman aged 55

summary.zh-CN: 无明显腹部体征的患者因影像发现肝占位就诊，需寻找原发部位并通过多学科评估安排后续治疗。
summary.en: A patient with no clear abdominal signs presents after liver lesions are detected; identify the primary site and formulate a multidisciplinary plan.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例改写。保留年龄、性别和临床证据；姓名为化名，病例文本中已去除医院、日历日期和职业身份细节；原文图表保留其原始标注（CEA曲线的横轴为治疗日期）。对话、问题、评分和安全选项为教学设计，未记录的数据明确未知。原文的肝脏MRI合图及转载该图的原文PDF含可识别信息，出于隐私保护未纳入。
notes.en: Adapted from a published case. Age, sex and clinical evidence are retained; names are pseudonyms and hospitals, calendar dates and identifying occupational details are removed from the case text; published figures keep their original annotations (the CEA curve’s axis shows treatment dates). Dialogue, questions, scoring and safety options are educational design; missing data remain unknown. The report’s liver MRI composite, and the source PDF that reprints it, carry identifying overlays and are withheld for privacy.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。结果由原报告提供，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not individual care or self-medication. Outcomes come from the report; undocumented physiological changes are not simulated.

text.zh-CN: 原报告先切除乙状结肠原发灶，病理为pT4N1cM1：6枚淋巴结未见转移，但有4枚癌结节。4周期FOLFOX加西妥昔单抗后肝灶部分缓解，接受肝切除，病理符合结肠来源。之后继续系统治疗；后来CEA再升、尾状叶新病灶，切除后肝门淋巴结1/1阳性，改FOLFIRI加西妥昔单抗后维持治疗。报告末次复查未见复发转移，但未证明永久治愈。
text.en: The source describes sigmoid resection with pT4N1cM1 pathology: no metastasis in six sampled nodes but four tumour deposits. After four FOLFOX/cetuximab cycles the hepatic disease partially responded and was resected, with colorectal-origin pathology. Systemic therapy continued. A later CEA rise and new caudate lesion led to another resection, with one of one hilar nodes positive, followed by FOLFIRI/cetuximab and maintenance. No recurrence was reported at the final assessment, but permanent cure is not established.

text.en: Colorectal, hepatobiliary and oncology teams address obstruction, assess conversion/resection options and complete molecular information required for current treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 可切除性需反复MDT判断；历史方案与有限分子结果不能直接代替今天的个体化选择。

text.en: Permanently exclude resection because liver lesions are multiple, or copy targeted therapy solely from the old KRAS result

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 可切除性与治疗目标随复评而变化；淋巴结0/6不等于N0，原报告癌结节使其列为N1c。
conclusion.en: Resectability and goals changed with reassessment; zero of six positive nodes did not imply N0 because tumour deposits were reported as N1c.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原发灶梗阻影响治疗先后顺序。
keyReasoning.en: Obstruction at the primary influenced treatment sequencing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: CEA变化需与影像和组织证据一起解读，不能单独确定复发或治愈。
keyReasoning.en: CEA trends require imaging and tissue context and do not alone establish recurrence or cure.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
